dataset_version: partition files as published by UNSW Canberra (page last updated 2021-06-02)
caveat: Lab datasets captured in 2015 (UNSW-NB15) and 2017 (CIC-IDS-2017). Scores on them say little about a real network today; the cross-dataset test (step 16) measures how badly the models transfer. Thresholds were chosen on the validation split and the test split was scored once. The uncleaned variant shows what the same pipeline reports without the leakage controls and is not a usable model.
